answer: In PoA, each identity bonds collateral in escrow, so splitting stake does not erase accountability. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting attestations, correlated penalties scale as O(k²), not as k independent fixed fines. Detection across repeated rounds compounds losses: asymmetric depreciation applies a multiplicative penalty, making the swarm’s capital loss exponential in the number of rounds. A fable of cheap identities offers no haven; linked evidence acts as a prism revealing coordination.
